name: compact-warning
description: Warns a session before auto-compaction, so it stops at a good breakpoint and hands you a ready /compact line.

warnPercent.title: First nudge (%)
warnPercent.description: Tell the session to look for a breakpoint at this percentage of the point where auto-compaction fires.

stopPercent.title: Second nudge (%)
stopPercent.description: Tell the session to stop at the next breakpoint at this percentage of the point where auto-compaction fires.

unattended.title: Compact without asking
unattended.description: When the session proposes a compaction, run it at once and tell the session to continue. Off: put the /compact line in the prompt box and wait for Enter.
